newsitem.title: USA: TVA 1,065 MW Ala. nuke boosting power.
newsitem.headline: TVA 1,065 MW Ala. nuke boosting power.

text.p: Tennessee Valley Authority's 1,065 megawatt (MW) Browns Ferry 3 nuclear power unit was operating at 20 percent of capacity as of early Thursday and increasing power, the Nuclear Regulatory Commission (NRC) said.
The unit, located in Decatur, Ala., was "increasing power following refueling outage," the NRC said in its daily plant status report for Thursday.
Browns Ferry 3 was taken off line Feb 22 for scheduled refueling and maintenance.
The adjoining Browns Ferry 2 nuclear power unit was operating at 100 percent of its 1,065 MW capacity as of early Thursday, the NRC said.
